item.title: Rockstar Confirms GTA 6 Won’t Reach 60 FPS on PS5 Pro
item.description: Rockstar says GTA 6 will run locked at 30 fps on PS5 Pro due to CPU limits, despite 1440p rendering, ray‑traced shadows and near‑4K upscaling.
